name: Pedanandipally
summary: A village where Sathya Sai Seva Samithi supports children through education, healthcare, village development and daily meal services for elders.

items.title: Evening Tuition Center
items.notes: Daily evening tuitions for government school children.

items.title: Bal Vikas Classes
items.notes: Weekly Bal Vikas classes focusing on values and bhajans.

items.title: Appointed Additional Teacher
items.notes: Samithi-sponsored teacher for primary classes.

items.title: School Development
items.notes: Regular support for repairs and infrastructure.

items.title: Bathroom Repairs
items.notes: Renovated school bathrooms for hygiene.

items.title: Sports & Games
items.notes: Sports kits and village-level sports events.

items.title: Stationary Distribution
items.notes: Books, pens, pencils and other stationary every academic year.

items.title: School Bags
items.notes: New school bags for children.

items.title: Clothes Distribution
items.notes: New clothes to selected families and children.

items.title: Other Educational Support
items.notes: Benches, blackboards and special requirements.

items.title: General Medical Camps
items.notes: Periodic medical camps with free consultation.

items.title: Free Medicines
items.notes: Essential medicines given to the needy during camps.

items.title: Surgery Support
items.notes: Financial help arranged for critical surgeries.

items.title: Veterinary Medical Camps
items.notes: Camps for cattle with free medicines.

items.title: RO Water Plant
items.notes: Established and maintained free RO water plant for the village.

items.title: Sanitation Support
items.notes: Support for sweepers, rickshaw for garbage collection and cleaning workers.

items.title: Tree Plantation
items.notes: Regular plantation drives around school and temple.

items.title: Temple Development
items.notes: Renovation and small extension of local temple.

items.title: Tailoring Classes
items.notes: Basic tailoring training for women.

items.title: Tailoring Machines Distribution
items.notes: Machines distributed to trained women for self-employment.

mealServices.description: Daily afternoon meals for selected elders and differently-abled individuals in the village.

specialSponsorDays.note: Families sponsor meals on children's birthdays.
Couples sponsor in gratitude for their marriage.

yearlyOverview.summary: Focused on strengthening education and Annadaatha Sukhibhava meals.

events.name: Swami's Birthday Celebrations
events.description: Children performed bhajans and skits; prasadam distributed to villagers.
Joint medical camp with nearby villages.

yearlyOverview.summary: Major focus on sanitation drive and Eswaramma Day celebration.

events.name: Eswaramma Day
events.description: Children participated on stage to overcome stage fear and understand Swami's ideals.
Village-wide cleanliness drive with youth and children.
